items.label: Frontend Engineering
items.descriptionLine1: I set the rules with types, cut repetition with components, and check performance as I go.
items.descriptionLine2: The bar is simple: leave code the next person can pick up and change.

items.label: UI/UX Design
items.descriptionLine1: With color, spacing, and states captured as tokens, the rules hold as screens multiply.
items.descriptionLine2: It gives designers and engineers one shared language to work from.

items.label: Plan to Deploy
items.descriptionLine1: It starts with what and why, and ends only after checking whether it is actually used.
items.descriptionLine2: The less that has to be handed off midway, the faster decisions land.

career.title: The path so far
career.subtitle: Started in design and publishing, then grew into engineering. The full record lives on the about page.

process.title: How the work actually goes
process.subtitle: Rather than transcribing a request, I first align on the problem it is meant to solve.

items.title: Agree on the problem
items.desc: What we are building, why, and how we will know it worked.

items.title: Set the rules
items.desc: Color, spacing, and component states become tokens so the system holds as it grows.

items.title: Build in small pieces
items.desc: Split into reviewable units instead of shipping everything at once.

items.title: Ship, then refine
items.desc: Release is not the end — watch the real flow and fix what catches.

intro.headline: I constantly strive to build products with better user experiences.
intro.desc1: With frontend/back-end training and UI/UX design, publishing, and planning experience, I collaborate flexibly across development, design, and planning.
intro.desc2: I lead projects from planning to deployment, contributing beyond implementation to raise product quality.

items.title: Web Development
items.description: I deliver user-friendly interfaces and performance by writing efficient frontend code. I work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, and more.

items.title: UI/UX Design
items.description: I design optimal UX based on user needs and expectations, using tools like Figma and Adobe XD to craft visual design and interactions.

items.title: Database Management (SQL)
items.description: I can query, insert, update, and delete data with SQL and work with Firebase/Firestore, MySQL, and PostgreSQL.

items.title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
items.description: I improve SEO through keyword research, meta tag optimization, and internal link structure improvements, using tools like Google Analytics for analysis.
